create_deepseekvl_model: create a DeepseekVL model for multimodal image-text understanding with vision encoder and language model
build_conditional_generation_model: build a DeepseekVLForConditionalGeneration model that generates text conditioned on input images
run_forward_inference: run forward pass of the DeepseekVL model with image pixel values and text input IDs for multimodal processing
get_image_features: get image features from the vision encoder aligned to text embedding space using the DeepseekVLAligner
prepare_inputs_for_generation: prepare inputs for autoregressive text generation with cached pixel values and past key values
